mentions.name: Meld Security
mentions.description: A service bundling security tools and data feeds into a single platform, enabling teams and individuals to run scans, analysis, and security project management on a freemium model. It lowers the technical hurdles of finding, running, and maintaining open-source security tools, includes a built-in expert platform for getting help on security problems, and has planned AI plugins for custom CVE alerting and automated scans.
mentions.problem: There are many great open-source security tools, but most people either don't know about them or lack the time to do a technical deep dive into each, making running and maintaining security tools technically difficult.
mentions.audience: Teams and individuals who need to run scans, analysis, and security projects
